extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants, examiners, classification clerks and IP professionals who assign or search goods/service classes
extracted.subtask_description: An excerpt from a goods/product classification index (class headings and subheadings) used to classify patents or registrations by the type of goods; the page lists class numbers, subsection headings and many example items that belong in each subclass.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 08 (continued) — Metal fittings/hardware items (fragment)
rubrics_metrics.description: Continuation listing of metal fittings, mountings and related small hardware items (fixings, hooks, rivets, clamps, straps, supports, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Long enumerated examples include: curtain rails and supports, hooks, clips, clamps, studs, rivets, wing nuts, washers (Belleville), grommets, coat/wardrobe hooks, knife holders, shower supports, radiator supports, chain links, chains, bicycle racks, hosepipe reels, suction cups, staples and straps, eyelets, studs, nails, mousquetons, and numerous other metal fixings and mountings. (This fragment shows how many small metal hardware goods are grouped under the class.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 09 — Packages and containers for the transport or handling of goods
rubrics_metrics.description: Top-level heading for packaging and container goods used for transport or handling.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encompasses bottles, flasks, jars, cans, drums, boxes, cases, carriers, racks, crates, bags, sacks, tubes, capsules, ropes and hooping materials, closing means and attachments, seals and stamps for packaging, and miscellaneous handling accessories (pallets, handles, carrying fixtures).

rubrics_metrics.name: 09-01 Bottles, flasks, pots, carboys, demijohns, and containers with dynamic dispensing means
rubrics_metrics.description: Containers for liquids and other materials, and dynamic dispensing apparatus associated with such containers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples listed: aerosol closures and valves, aerosol dispensing apparatus, ampullae (packaging), beer bottles, bottle coverings, spray caps for aerosol containers, deodorant dynamic dispensers, liquid gas cartridges for cigarette lighters, compressed gas steel cylinders, jars (packaging), phials, demijohns, and dispensing heads/valves for aerosol containers.

rubrics_metrics.name: 09-021 Storage cans, drums and casks
rubrics_metrics.description: Large containers and vessels for storage and transport such as barrels, casks, drums, buckets, canisters and related cooperage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: small barrels and kegs, large barrels and tuns, drums (containers), sanitary buckets, canisters, storage cans, jerrycans, vats, wine vats, casks, barrels, tuns, spigots (cooperage), and associated closures for aerosols and bottles.

rubrics_metrics.name: 09-031 Boxes, cases, containers (preserve) tins or cans
rubrics_metrics.description: Packaging boxes and cases used for preservation, transport and storage, including specialized carriers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: bottle carriers and racks for transport, cardboard packaging boxes, glove boxes, hat boxes, match boxes, egg cartons, packing cases, biscuit/chocolate/confectionery boxes, tetrahedral milk cartons and carriers, cigarette packets, motion picture storage cans, preserve tins, shipping/freight containers and various disposable packaging containers.

rubrics_metrics.name: 09-041 Hampers, crates and baskets
rubrics_metrics.description: Open or partially open containers for carrying or collection such as hampers, crates and baskets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: grape-picking baskets, hampers, crates, and decorative/functional baskets for holding flowerpots or produce.

rubrics_metrics.name: 09-051 Bags, sachets, tubes and capsules
rubrics_metrics.description: Flexible packaging: bags, sachets, tubes, capsules used for packaging general or specialty goods (including pharmaceutical).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: paper bags, mail bags, tea/coffee sachets, pill containers, tubes for packaging, ice-cream cornet containers, packaging sleeves for phonographic discs, postal sacks, and capsules/envelopes for pharmaceutical products.

rubrics_metrics.name: 09-061 Ropes and hooping materials
rubrics_metrics.description: Ropes, straps, webbing, binder strings, hooping and related materials used in packaging and handling.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: bands, straps, webbing, barrel rims, binder strings, binding yarns for sheaves, bundle carrier ties, clothes lines, cordage, hooping materials, ties for sheaves, ties for bales, and webbing used in packaging or carriers.

rubrics_metrics.name: 09-071 Closing means and attachments
rubrics_metrics.description: Devices and fittings used to close, seal, fasten or attach packaging and containers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples include bottle fastenings, stoppers, cork-wiring for bottles, dispensing stoppers, measuring stoppers, lead stamps or seals for packaging, seal rings, sealing bands, spray-stopper caps with built-in devices, seals for packaging containers, cork stoppers, dispensing caps, capsules for bottles, and various closures and sealing rings.

rubrics_metrics.name: 09-99 Miscellaneous (packaging/handling accessories)
rubrics_metrics.description: Catch-all for packaging and handling related miscellaneous items not allocated to other subheadings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: handles for carrying parcels, pallets (forklift platforms), forklift accessories, carrying handles, pallet platforms for handling, and other sundry handling fixtures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 10 — Clocks and watches and other measuring instruments, checking and signalling instruments
rubrics_metrics.description: Top-level heading covering timekeeping devices and a wide range of measuring, checking and signalling instruments and their accessories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes clocks, watches, timers, chronographs, meters (electricity, gas, water), gauges, indicators, measuring apparatus for many domains (marine, surveying, medical), instruments for checking/security/testing, signalling devices (road/rail/sea/air), and all parts/accessories for these instruments.

rubrics_metrics.name: 10-011 Clocks and alarm clocks
rubrics_metrics.description: Mechanical and electric clocks, alarm clocks and special-purpose timepieces.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: alarm clocks (also electric), astronomical clocks, regulators (electric), geographical clocks, small clocks, pendulum clocks, and related clock mechanisms.

rubrics_metrics.name: 10-C21 Watches and wrist watches
rubrics_metrics.description: Watches including wrist watches and alarm watches.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: alarm watches, wrist watches (including electric), watch bracelets and straps, watch movements and accessories.

rubrics_metrics.name: 10-031 Other time-measuring instruments
rubrics_metrics.description: Timers and instruments for measuring time other than conventional clocks and watches.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: automatic timers, chronographs, chronometers, chronometric counters, parking meters, metronomes, sandglasses, kitchen timers (minute timers).

rubrics_metrics.name: 10-041 Other measuring instruments, apparatus and devices
rubrics_metrics.description: A broad category covering measuring instruments across many physical domains (pressure, temperature, distance, electrical quantities, surveying, marine, laboratory).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Long list of examples: accelerometers, accumulators (charge indicators), acoustic measuring instruments, aerometers, alcoholometers, altimeters, ammeters, anemometers, balances (assay and other), barometers, calipers, calorimeters, compasses (including marine), distance measuring, draft apparatus for ships, dynamometers, echo sounders, electricity meters, flowmeters, fuel-consumption indicators, gauges (pressure, tyre), hydrostatic/level indicators, micrometers, spectrophotometers, thermometers (including medical), taximeters, tape measures and cases, water meters, wattmeters, and many other specialized measuring devices (surveying, marine, medical, industrial).

rubrics_metrics.name: 10-05 Instruments, apparatus and devices for checking, security or testing
rubrics_metrics.description: Instruments and apparatus used for testing, checking, safety and security (including alarms and detectors).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: burglar alarms, fire alarms and detectors, lightning arresters, boiler water shortage alarms, brake‑testing machines, checking apparatus, Geiger counters, fluid analyzers, testing machines for woven fabrics, fall controllers for parachutists, theft-prevention devices for paintings, frost indicators, humidity detectors, hydrophones, photometric testing equipment, radar, radiation detectors, seismographs, and related recorder/register equipment.

rubrics_metrics.name: 10-06 Signalling apparatus and devices
rubrics_metrics.description: Devices used for signalling and marking in transport and safety contexts (road, rail, sea, air and personal warning devices).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples include traffic lights/signals, beacons for air and sea transport, lighthouses, traffic signs and road-marking devices, railway signals and semaphore signals, buoys, fog signals, marker buoys, breakdown triangles for motorists, cycle bells, horns and warning horns for vehicles, door chimes/knockers, marking devices for ski slopes, and fixed signalling lamps for transport installations.

rubrics_metrics.name: 10-07 Casings, dials, hands and all other parts and accessories of measuring, checking and signalling instruments
rubrics_metrics.description: Spare parts, casings and components for clocks, watches and other measuring/checking/signalling instruments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: watch and clock cases, watch bracelets and chains, clasps for watch straps, crowns (winding) of watches, dials, hands/pointers, escapements, hairsprings, pivots, jewel settings, movements (chassis), winding mechanisms, balance springs, watch winders, bezels (rims) in which glass is set, and many other small components specific to horology and instrument manufacture.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 11 — Articles of adornment / Jewelry
rubrics_metrics.description: Top-level heading covering jewelry, personal adornments, and related decorative items.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes bracelets and bracelet links, brooches, chains, charms, clips, diadems, cut diamonds (brilliants), ear pendants, earrings, finger rings (signet and wedding rings), gems and precious stones, hair fasteners/ornaments, lockets, medallions, necklaces, pendants, pins, pearls, solitaires, and other jewelry articles.

rubrics_metrics.name: 11-02 Trinkets, table, mantel and wall ornaments, flower vases and pots
rubrics_metrics.description: Decorative household articles and ornamental objects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples include ornamental baskets, bas-reliefs, flower vases, ornamental pots, aquarium-type flower holders and other trinkets or decorative containers for domestic display.
